advisory.description: v1 safety invariant: must be true.

tools.description: The canonical tool vocabulary. Entries are matched case- and separator-insensitively (Read, web-fetch, Web_Search all resolve); each renderer maps them to its IDE's own tool names. An entry outside the vocabulary is E021.

model.description: Abstract cost/latency tier — never a concrete model ID. Each renderer maps it to that IDE's model names at compile time.
